message: Stats can now tell you when you actually get things done: an hour-by-hour shape of your day, tinted by morning, afternoon, evening and night, with the stretch you finish most in called out. Underneath it, any task whose time of day doesn't match reality: mark something Morning, finish it in the evening enough times, and it offers to re-file it in a tap. The task editor's Time of day row has a matching "From history" button that picks a part of the day from your own past completions, and says nothing when it hasn't seen enough to tell.
